name: Cortex
description: Observable analysis and active response engine that runs analyzers for TheHive and other case management tools.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    command: "--search.host {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch --search.port 9200 --job-directory /data/jobs"
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      JVM_OPTS: {{env.JVM_OPTS}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
  {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:7.17.24
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: false
